responsibility: Defines the MSP430 target’s RTL operand constraints used by the machine description recognizer and reload. It classifies MSP430-specific register operands such as R12/R13, immediate ranges used by shifts and instruction encodings, and several memory-address classes that distinguish label references, call-safe addresses, low-memory references, and addresses that can avoid the 430X X-suffix. These constraints are consumed throughout msp430.md to select valid instruction alternatives and enforce addressing restrictions tied to 16-bit vs 20-bit memory access.
